imageEvidence.normalization: Center crop only; 2 px left, 3 px right, 4 px top and 4 px bottom removed; no resampling.
visualInspection: Exactly twelve distinct full-body poses are visible in a 3x4 portrait layout.
Hero face, black faceted hair, teal-and-ochre cloak, ivory tunic, dark trousers, bracers, boots and paddle-blade remain recognizably consistent.
No cell clips the body or weapon after normalization; no text, labels, borders, scenery or extra characters are present.
Pose order matches the action table: idle neutral, combat idle, walk, run, observe, light 1, light 2, heavy, dodge, parry, hit, namebreak.

verification.command: PowerShell JSON parse for five modified JSON files
PowerShell image dimension and aspect assertion

knownGaps: The generated sheet does not prove frame timing, rig quality, skinning, root motion, foot locking or weapon collision.
The second light attack is a visual proposal; the current reducer has no combo index or input buffer.
Run is a future locomotion pose; the current build has movement but no distinct run state.
Neutral gray includes soft studio falloff and contact shadows, so it is not a pixel-uniform segmentation background.
